title: The Parson's Daughter of Oxney Colne
sourceTitle: The Parson's Daughter of Oxney Colne
author: Anthony Trollope
description: "The Parson's Daughter of Oxney Colne" by Anthony Trollope is a short story written during the mid-19th century, a time associated with the Victorian era.
longDescription: The book primarily explores social class dynamics, love, and personal sacrifice through the lens of a young woman navigating her emotions and societal expectations in a rural English setting.

authorInfo.bio: Anthony Trollope (1815–1882) is the author of The Warden. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
